description: This file contains API utility functions for fetching module overview data, metrics, and derived modules from various endpoints in a web application's frontend. It includes functions getModules and getOverviewMetrics, which perform network requests to retrieve and process data related to modules, deployments, users, and costs.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches modules or overview data for the authenticated user/tenant by trying multiple endpoints and deriving modules from other data if primary endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total users and deployed applications metrics for the overview screen.
